evidence_items.source_quote: The AC aqueous was sent for polymerase chain reaction (PCR) to rule out infectious etiology including herpetic infection, cytomegalovirus, varicella zoster, tuberculosis, and Chlamydia which were all negative.

rationale: Listeria monocytogenes endophthalmitis post-LASIK; aqueous humor PCR for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: CMV IgM was negative and IgG was positive.

rationale: HELLP syndrome with hepatic rupture; CMV IgM was negative and IgG was positive, indicating latent seropositivity rather than acute CMV infection (E0 contradicted).

evidence_items.source_quote: Biliary obstruction, vascular thromboses and infections, including cytomegalovirus, were excluded (Figure 4).

rationale: Post-OLT graft failure; infections including cytomegalovirus were excluded (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Test results for maternal serum cytomegalovirus and parvovirus B19 IgM were negative.

rationale: Fetal chylous ascites; maternal serum cytomegalovirus IgM was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: PCR for JC, CMV, HHV6, HSV and VZV virus in the CSF were negative.

rationale: EBV-positive CNS lymphoproliferative disorder on ruxolitinib; CSF PCR for CMV was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Labs were significant for negative polymerase chain reaction (PCR) for Epstein-Barr virus (EBV), cytomegalovirus (CMV), human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), hepatitis B virus (HBV), and hepatitis C virus (HCV).

rationale: Topiramate-induced agranulocytosis; PCR for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Indirect serodiagnosis for the common pathogens causing reactive arthritis (i.e., Yersinia, Shigella, Salmonella, Campylobacter jejuni, Parvovirus B19, Echovirus, Coxsackievirus, CMV, EBV, mycoplasma) as well as throat culture and streptococcal antibody titers were negative.

rationale: Gaucher disease acute bone crisis; indirect serodiagnosis for CMV was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Additional laboratory tests included anti-streptolysin titer 237 IU/ml (normal 0 - 350 IU/ml), negative anti-nuclear antibodies (ANA), negative Mycoplasma IgM, and negative viral studies for IgM antibodies for EBV, CMV, Adenovirus, Measles, and Rubella.

rationale: Parvovirus B19 myositis and rash; viral IgM studies for CMV were negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Serology for HIV, HBV, HCV, CMV and EBV returned negative.

rationale: Tuberculous parotitis; serology for CMV returned negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: After six months' steroid treatment, relapse of anemia and decreased platelet count were observed due to cytomegalovirus infection.

rationale: 15-year-old girl with lupus nephritis and TTP; relapse of anemia and thrombocytopenia due to CMV infection occurred 6 months earlier (historical past, not current episode).

evidence_items.source_quote: Serological studies of Epstein-Barr virus, cytomegalovirus, human immunodeficiency virus, hepatitis A, B, and C, and mycoplasma were normal.

rationale: Carbamazepine-induced DRESS syndrome and myocarditis; serological studies of cytomegalovirus were normal (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Acid-fast bacilli (AFB), cytomegalovirus, herpes simplex and varicella zoster viruses, and Warthin-Starry staining were negative.

rationale: HIV with rupioid secondary syphilis IRIS; skin biopsy staining for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Other infectious workups including CMV, EBV, Lyme, Rocky Mountain spotted fever, Cryptococcus, and chlamydia were all negative.

rationale: Ehrlichiosis post-OLT; infectious workup for CMV was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: All other virological and microbiological CSF investigations were negative (antibody indices for CMV/HSV/VZV, CMV pp65 antigen, EBV antibodies and PCR, JCV PCR, HIV antigen ELISA, tuberculosis culture and PCR, aspergillus antigen ELISA, leptospirosis antibodies, cryptococcus antigen immunodiffusion, toxoplasmosis antibodies, borrelia antibodies, culture for neisseria and brucella and an unspecific culture for other pathogenic and non-pathogenic bacteria).
evidence_items.test_name: CSF CMV antibody index and pp65

rationale: VZV retinitis and vasculitis on natalizumab; CSF CMV antibody index and pp65 antigen were negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: No other abnormality was found from further testing, including blood tests for regular auto-immune disorders, serological tests for herpes simplex virus, cytomegalovirus, viral hepatitis B and C, human immunodeficiency virus, syphilis, as well as blood sampling for vitamins B 12, PP, and ceruloplasmin.

rationale: Hashimoto's encephalopathy; serological test for cytomegalovirus showed no abnormality (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Toxoplasmosis, syphilis, rubella, cytomegalovirus, and herpes serologies had not been performed.

rationale: Pulmonary aplasia in a 4-month-old infant; cytomegalovirus serology had not been performed and there was no suspicion of CMV.

evidence_items.source_quote: The Coombs' test and toxoplasmosis, rubella, cytomegalovirus, herpes simplex, and HIV (TORCH) screening were negative.

rationale: Preterm neonate with urinary ascites; TORCH screening including cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Screening for viral infections (HIV, hepatitis B virus (HBV)/hepatitis C virus (HCV), cytomegalovirus (CMV), Epstein-Barr virus (EBV), parvovirus-B19) and autoimmunity was negative except for subclinical hypothyroidism.

rationale: COVID-19-associated ITP; screening for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: CSF cultures and PCR panels (including COVID-19 RNA, HSV, VZV, EBV, and CMV) were negative.

rationale: COVID-19 ARDS and leukoencephalopathy; CSF PCR panel for CMV was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: CSF cultures and PCR panels including COVID-19 RNA, HSV, VZV, EBV, and CMV were negative.

rationale: COVID-19 ARDS and leukoencephalopathy (son of case 304); CSF PCR panel for CMV was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: The posttransplant course was also characterized by several CMV reactivations and multiple infections of skin ulcers, complicated by recurrent sepsis and one episode of septic shock caused by Pseudomonas aeruginosa (July 2018).

rationale: Donor-cell MDS 5 years post-allo-SCT for Ph+ B-ALL; CMV reactivations occurred in the earlier post-transplant course years before current presentation (historical past).

evidence_items.source_quote: The blood analysis showed no abnormalities, including tests for HIV, Epstein-Barr virus, cytomegalovirus, Treponema pallidum, chlamydya, IgG, IgA, IgM, antitransglutaminase antibody, antiendomisium antibody, ANA, anti-DNA, anti-Ro, anti-La, anti-Sm, and rheumatoid factor.

rationale: Child with autoinflammatory episodes; blood analysis including cytomegalovirus showed no abnormalities (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: In addition, CMV, EBV, VZV, and HSV were negative.

rationale: Yogi Detox herbal tea-induced acute liver failure; CMV testing was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Patient was also tested for infectious diseases including HIV, syphilis, cytomegalovirus, tuberculosis, and hepatitis, but all tests were negative.

rationale: Streptococcus pyogenes necrotizing conjunctivitis; testing for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Specific serologic tests for human immunodeficiency virus, cytomegalovirus, Epstein-Barr virus, rubella virus, toxoplasma gondii and parvovirus were negative.

rationale: Turner syndrome with central diabetes insipidus; serologic test for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Anti-HSV, anti-EBV and anti-CMV IgM's were also negative.

rationale: CVID with AA amyloidosis; anti-CMV IgM was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: An immunohistochemical stain for cytomegalovirus was negative.

rationale: COVID-19 with lower GI bleeding; colonic biopsy immunohistochemical stain for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: No viral cytopathic effects for CMV or HSV were seen; hence, immunohistochemical stains were not undertaken. Serological tests for CMV were negative.

rationale: COVID-19 with lower GI bleeding; no viral cytopathic effects for CMV on cecal biopsy and serological tests for CMV were negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: The results of Epstein-Barr virus (EBV)-DNA and cytomegalovirus (CMV)-DNA were negative.

rationale: MonoMAC syndrome (GATA2) with M. kansasii infection; CMV-DNA was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Serologies were ordered for leptospirosis, rickettsialpox, hepatitis, syphilis, Zika virus, Chikungunya, Epstein-Barr virus, cytomegalovirus, toxoplasmosis, and human immunodeficiency virus (HIV). All of them had negative results.

rationale: Moraxella osloensis infective endocarditis; serology for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: We also tested for Cryptococcus neoformans (agglutination test), Cytomegalovirus spp. (antigenemia), tuberculosis (three gastric lavages) and respiratory viruses (nasal secretion tests), with all negative results.

rationale: Pediatric T-ALL with pulmonary alveolar calcification; Cytomegalovirus antigenemia test was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Infectious evaluation for systemic viral infections including EBV, CMV, herpes simplex virus, human herpesvirus 6, and adenovirus (ADV) were negative.

rationale: TBX1 haploinsufficiency SCID; infectious evaluation for CMV was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Routine blood and CSF analysis (cell count, glucose and protein level) were normal and investigation for infectious pathogens (varicella zoster virus, herpes zoster virus, cytomegalovirus, mumps, rubella, borrelia burgdorferi, treponema pallidum) were negative.

rationale: Autoimmune encephalitis / Alzheimer's disease; CSF/blood investigation for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: The patient had negative blood and sputum cultures, negative serological test for Cryptococcus and Aspergillus, negative sputum for PCP and acid-fast bacilli, negative viral testing (including cytomegalovirus, Epstein-Barr virus, human immunodeficiency virus, etc.), and normal autoimmune testing (including serum immunoglobulins, complement segments, anti-neutrophil antibody, anti-neutrophil cytoplasmic antibody, rheumatoid factor, etc.).

rationale: Organizing pneumonia with MDS; viral testing including cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Bacteria, mycobacterium tuberculosis, virus (e.g., herpes simplex encephalitis virus, cytomegalovirus, and Epstein-Barr virus), and fungal cultures from CSF and blood serology, with PCR also performed, were negative.

rationale: ADEM post-Hepatitis B vaccination; CSF culture/serology and PCR for cytomegalovirus were negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: On POD-13, the patient's serum PCT levels dropped to 3 ng/mL, blood cultures were negative, and cytomegalovirus, Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) were negative, but the fever did not subside, and obscure red spots were also observed on the patient's chest.

rationale: Liver transplant-associated GVHD; cytomegalovirus testing on POD-13 was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Serologic markers for hepatitis A, B, C, and E viruses, and Epstein-Barr virus, cytomegalovirus, varicella zoster virus, and herpes simplex virus were all negative, and anti-Helicobacter pylori (H. pylori) IgG was positive (Table 1).

rationale: Autoimmune hepatitis with ITP; serologic markers for cytomegalovirus were negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: CMV antigenemia was diagnosed on day 42, and he was successfully treated with ganciclovir.

rationale: 52-year-old man presenting 5 years post-allo-HSCT with donor-derived DLBCL; CMV antigenemia on day 42 post-HSCT occurred 5 years earlier (historical past).

evidence_items.source_quote: He received letermovir prophylaxis until day 100, and he did not develop CMV antigenemia.

rationale: Second allo-HSCT for donor-derived DLBCL; received letermovir prophylaxis until day 100 and did not develop CMV antigenemia (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: In addition, initial results showed seropositivity for HSV-2 immunoglobulin G (IgG), Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) IgG and CMV IgG.

rationale: Fulminant HSV-2 hepatitis; CMV IgG was positive (latent seropositivity) and empiric ganciclovir was switched to acyclovir once HSV-2 was confirmed (E0 contradicted).

evidence_items.source_quote: Staining with monoclonal antibody conjugates for cytomegalovirus and human herpes simplex viruses was also negative.

rationale: Facial herpes zoster (VZV-BC strain); monoclonal antibody staining for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Pre-transplant serology demonstrated previous Cytomegalovirus and Epstein-Barr virus infection in the recipient.

rationale: Niemann-Pick disease type B undergoing bilateral lung transplant; pre-transplant serology showed only previous CMV infection (historical past).

evidence_items.source_quote: On March 2008, the patient presented a complex clinical picture including an interstitial pneumonitis by Mycoplasma pneumoniae and Chlamydia pneumoniae, Epstein Barr and cytomegalovirus infections, tubulointerstitial nephritis, severe lymphopenia, and marked reduction of CD4 (214 cells/muL, Tables 1 and 2).

rationale: IgG4-related disease diagnosed in 2014; CMV infection occurred in March 2008, 6 years prior to current presentation (historical past).

evidence_items.source_quote: PCR assays for Mycobacterium tuberculosis-DNA, Epstein Barr virus (EBV)-DNA and cytomegalovirus-DNA on CSF were all negative.

rationale: HIV with CNS toxoplasmosis; CSF PCR for cytomegalovirus-DNA was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Serological tests for viral infections, including hepatitis A and B, Epstein-Barr virus, human immunodeficiency virus, and cytomegalovirus, were all negative.

rationale: Piperacillin/tazobactam-induced drug fever; serological test for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Very low copies of cytomegalovirus (CMV) were detectable on BAL sample but there were judged not enough for diagnosis of pulmonary CMV infection. CMV DNA on whole blood was negative and patient was not treated with antiviral therapy.

rationale: Multiple myeloma on daratumumab-lenalidomide-dexamethasone; very low CMV copies on BAL were judged insufficient for pulmonary CMV infection, whole blood CMV DNA was negative, and no antiviral was given (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: CMV and HSV stains were negative and the biopsy was negative for H. pylori and malignancy as well.

rationale: Gastric mucormycosis post-kidney transplant; gastric biopsy CMV stain was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Viral tests in CSF (herpes, varicella, Epstein-Barr virus, Parvovirus, cytomegalovirus, adenovirus) remained negative.

rationale: Pneumococcal meningoencephalitis; CSF viral test for cytomegalovirus remained negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: CSF polymerase chain reaction (PCR) panel was positive for WNV and negative for CMV, human herpes virus-6, rabies, John Cunningham virus, herpes simplex virus (HSV) 1 and 2, dengue, Japanese encephalitis (JE), nipah, chikungunya, chandipura, mumps, measles and enterovirus including poliovirus, fungi and bacteria including Myobacterium tuberculosis on day 7 (Xcyton acute encephalitis syndrome [AES], Bangalore).

rationale: West Nile virus poliomyelitis; CSF PCR panel was negative for CMV (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: PCR for bacteria, including Mycobacterium tuberculosis, Streptococcus pneumonia, Neisseria meningitidis and HSV, CMV and varicella zoster virus were negative.

rationale: West Nile virus myelitis; CSF PCR for CMV was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: In the analysis of the vitreous sample, the results of PCR for VZV, HSV, CMV, and Toxoplasma were all negative, except for EBV deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) in both eyes.

rationale: Primary intraocular lymphoma; vitreous PCR for CMV was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Further testing of CSF was negative for Cytomegalovirus, West Nile virus, herpes simplex virus, varicella zoster virus, as well as other bacterial and fungal pathogens.

rationale: CD5-negative mantle cell lymphoma with CNS involvement; CSF testing for Cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: PCR screening for Epstein-Barr virus DNA (EBV-DNA) (-) and human cytomegalovirus DNA (HCMV-DNA) (-) was used to eliminate infectious diseases (Supplementary Table S3).

rationale: Cyclic neutropenia (ELANE); PCR screening for human cytomegalovirus DNA was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: CMV PCR, acid-fast bacilli and Epstein Barr virus testing was negative.

rationale: Crohn's-like colitis post-HSCT for CGD; esophageal biopsies were negative for CMV and colonoscopy CMV PCR was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: The first was a 52-year-old female with panel reactive antibody (PRA) 0%, 3 human leukocyte antigen (HLA) mismatch (MM) with the donor, CMV negative, and Epstein Barr virus (EBV) immune. The second recipient was a 51-year-old female with PRA 50%, 6 HLA MM, CMV positive, and EBV immune.

rationale: Two kidney transplant recipients from a donor with herpes zoster; CMV serostatus (negative/positive) is mentioned at baseline without any CMV infection.

evidence_items.source_quote: From day + 7; the patient started a prophylaxis for Cytomegalovirus infection with letermovir 240 mg os per day.
Subsequently, blood tests, including cytomegalovirus (CMV), HHV6 and Epstein-Barr virus (EBV)-DNA, were performed weekly.

rationale: AML post-allo-HSCT with EBV-PTLD; recipient was CMV seropositive (D-/R+), received letermovir prophylaxis, and had weekly CMV-DNA monitoring without CMV reactivation (E0 contradicted).

evidence_items.source_quote: In the early post-transplant period, he developed: febrile neuotropenia empirically treated with cefepime and gentamicin and cytomegalovirus infection treated with IV ganciclovir.

rationale: 52-year-old male with pre-B ALL post-auto-HSCT in 2004, relapsing in 2006; early post-transplant CMV infection in 2004 was years prior to relapse and death (historical past).

evidence_items.source_quote: Further workups including routine blood test, blood glucose, electrolytes, serum ammonia, lactic acid levels, fatty acids, ceruloplasmin, serological markers for viruses (cytomegalovirus, Epstein-Barr virus, hepatitis virus), toxoplasmosis, thyroid function, creatinine, uric acid, autoimmune serology and immunoglobulin levels, all of which showed normal results.

rationale: 4-year-old girl with hepatomegaly and elevated transaminases; serological markers for cytomegalovirus were normal (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: The histochemical study for Helicobacter pylori and the immunohistochemical study for CMV were negative (Figure 3). CMV serology was also negative.
evidence_items.test_name: gastric biopsy CMV IHC and serology

rationale: Menetrier's disease in an 11-year-old boy; gastric biopsy had no CMV inclusions, CMV immunohistochemistry was negative, and CMV serology was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: On POD 16 routine quantitative PCR for cytomegalovirus DNA was positive (41UI/ml 1,62 log (UI/ml)), but did not require antiviral therapy nor reduction in the immunosuppressive regimen.
Pathological examination of biopsies from the gastric pouch and the alimentary limb was negative for inflammatory alterations, cytomegalovirus or HP.

rationale: 45-year-old woman post-LT with perforated gastric ulcer; baseline CMV IgG+ with negative DNA PCR, trivial transient POD 16 CMV DNA (41 IU/mL) not requiring therapy, and negative follow-up PCR/biopsy (incidental/E3).

evidence_items.source_quote: An extensive workup was performed including viral hepatitis and CMV serologies and Helicobacter pylori stool antigen which were all negative.

rationale: Celiac disease triggered by ipilimumab/nivolumab; CMV serologies were negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: There was no evidence of an autoimmune disorder, that is, no antibodies against H or I factors, exploration of complement activity showed no activation (CH50 = 150%; C3 = 1,260 mg/L [550-1,650]; B factor = 315 mg/L [216-504]; C5 = 271 mg/L [120-220]), and no evidence of bacteremia and viremia (CMV, EBV, and hepatitis B, C and E viruses) in the analyses.

rationale: Paraneoplastic TMA in metastatic breast cancer; no evidence of CMV viremia (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Infectious causes (including bacterial infection, tuberculosis, human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), cytomegalovirus (CMV), and Eppstein-Barr virus (EBV) infection), autoimmune and pharmacological causes, were excluded as the potential triggers, and thus CLL progression was assumed as the etiology of the HLH.

rationale: CLL progression-associated HLH; CMV infection was excluded as a trigger (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: PCR tests for enterovirus, Epstein-Barr virus, cytomegalovirus, and herpes simplex viruses were negative.

rationale: Acute intermittent porphyria; CSF PCR test for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Serological results for human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), Epstein-Barr virus, cytomegalovirus, hepatitis virus B and C, COVID-19, and the T-cell spot test for tuberculosis infection (T-SPOT) were negative.

rationale: Disseminated Histoplasma capsulatum with HLH; serological result for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Five months after RT, the patient had a CMV infection treated with ganciclovir with success.

rationale: 53-year-old man presenting 5 years post-renal transplant with intestinal TB; CMV infection occurred 5 months after transplant in 2007, 5 years before current presentation (historical past).

evidence_items.source_quote: She underwent a deceased kidney transplantation in 2007, (CMV donor+/recipient+).

rationale: 53-year-old woman with intestinal TB 3 years post-renal transplant; only pre-transplant CMV donor+/recipient+ serostatus is mentioned (historical past).

evidence_items.source_quote: Further testing revealed a ferritin of 7953 ng/mL, IL-2 receptor alpha interleukin 8592, EBV PCR <100 copies/mL, and CMV PCR neg.

rationale: HIV with HHV-8 multicentric Castleman disease and Kaposi sarcoma; CMV PCR was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: After a complete diagnostic workup including repeated bacterial and mycobacterial cultures, QuantiFERON1-TB Gold test, blood CMV-PCR, blood Aspergillus galactomannan and Candida mannan, immunofluorescent staining of bronchoalveolar fluid for Pneumocystis jiroveci, other pulmonary opportunistic infections were ruled out, and a diagnosis of A. denitrificans pneumonia and EVR pulmonary toxicity was made.

rationale: Achromobacter denitrificans pneumonia and everolimus lung toxicity post-kidney transplant; blood CMV-PCR ruled out CMV infection (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Serological testing for Toxoplasma, Bartonella, HIV, parvovirus, Cytomegalovirus, Borrelia, Rickettsia and Herpes virus 1 and 2 were negative.

rationale: Relapsed T-ALL with CNS involvement; serological testing for Cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Serological tests for HIV, Hepatitis B and C virus, CMV (for both IgM and IgG), EBV (for both IgM and IgG), HTLV1, and Parvovirus were negative. PCR blood test did not reveal viral replication for CMV and HHV8.
evidence_items.test_name: CMV IgM/IgG and blood CMV PCR

rationale: TAFRO-like syndrome; CMV IgM/IgG serologies and blood CMV PCR were negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: No active infection was detected for hepatitis viruses, cytomegalovirus, or Epstein-Barr virus.

rationale: Herbal paste-induced DRESS syndrome; no active CMV infection was detected (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Tuberculin skin testing and serologies for human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), syphilis, cytomegalovirus, and Epstein-Barr virus were all negative.

rationale: Visceral leishmaniasis; serology for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Also, CSF HSV and Cytomegalovirus (CMV) PCR were negative along with negative West Nile virus (WNV) Ab.

rationale: TMP/SMX-induced aseptic meningitis; CSF Cytomegalovirus PCR was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: The following tests were negative or normal on evaluation:viral hepatitis serologies, serologic markers of autoimmune hepatitis, serology for Lyme disease, HIV, CMV, and EBV serologies.

rationale: Chinese Skullcap drug-induced liver injury; CMV serology was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: A screening for infectious disease was also performed, which showed a past EBV and CMV infection.

rationale: Thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura; infectious screening showed only past CMV infection (historical past, E0 contradicted).

evidence_items.source_quote: Epstein-Barr virus in situ hybridization (EBER), p16, cytomegalovirus and mycobacteria were negative.

rationale: Granulomatous lingual tonsillitis with hypogammaglobulinemia; biopsy testing for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Both the donor and recipient were CMV IgG negative, therefore, CMV prophylaxis was not required as per hospital policy.

rationale: Donor-derived visceral leishmaniasis post-OLT; both donor and recipient were CMV IgG negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Eight months later, she developed a severe CMV colitis with prolonged hospital stay and her baseline creatinine remained at 2.6 mg/dL.

rationale: 47-year-old kidney transplant recipient presenting in May 2020 with malignant hypertension-associated TMA; severe CMV colitis occurred ~1 year earlier (historical past, not current episode).

evidence_items.source_quote: The cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) composition was normal; real-time PCR assay for pathogens associated with CNS infection [herpes simplex virus (HSV)1, HSV2, varicella zoster virus (VZV), human herpesvirus (HHV)6, cytomegalovirus (CMV), enterovirus, parechovirus, Neisseria meningitidis, Haemophilus influenzae, Streptococcus pneumoniae, E. coli, Listeria monocytogenes, and Cryptococcus neoformans] was negative.

rationale: Microscopic polyangiitis; CSF real-time PCR for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Serologies and DNA tests were negative for viral infections (CMV, EBV, HIV, and Parvovirus).

rationale: Good's syndrome with pure red cell aplasia and aplastic anemia; serology and DNA test for CMV were negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: The remaining haematological, microbiological, virological, and biochemical parameters including blood cultures and investigation for hepatitis viruses A, B, C, and E as well as Epstein-Barr virus (EBV), cytomegalovirus (CMV), human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), herpes simplex virus (HSV), tuberculosis, leishmaniasis, brucellosis, and leptospirosis were negative.

rationale: Acute severe autoimmune hepatitis; investigation for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Since our patient showed raised levels of liver function tests, we further checked for HBsAg, HCV Ab, HAV Ab (IgM), HIV Ab, EBV Ab (VCA IgM), CMV Ab (IgM), anti-mitochondrial antibody, anti-smooth muscle antibody, and liver kidney microsomal antibody; all were negative.

rationale: Neurobrucellosis; CMV IgM antibody was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Another diagnosis that was initially considered was cytomegalovirus (CMV) colitis, but this was thought to be less likely due to undetected serum CMV level.

rationale: Neutropenic enterocolitis post-heart transplant; CMV colitis was considered unlikely due to undetected serum CMV level (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: The following serological studies were carried out: hepatitis A virus; Epstein-Barr virus; Trypanosoma cruzi; cytomegalovirus; Ac HBs; Ag HBs; Ac HBc T; HIV 1 + 2; Toxoplasma gondii; Entamoeba histolytica; Echinococcus granulosus; Taenia solium (IgG); Leishmania spp.; strongyloides and schistosoma. All results were negative and do not showed acute infection, except schistosoma with IgM and IgG positive.

rationale: Schistosomiasis; serology for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: IgM ELISA with for Ebstein Barr virus (EBV), cytomegalovirus (CMV), and parvo-virus were all negative.

rationale: Vitamin B12 deficiency-induced pyrexia and hemolysis; CMV IgM ELISA was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Immunohistochemistry of ileal biopsies for cytomegalovirus was negative.

rationale: Ulcerative colitis with pouchitis and prepouch ileitis; immunohistochemistry of ileal biopsies for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: EBV and HCMV capsid antigen IgG, but not IgM, was positive, indicating historic rather than recent EBV and HCMV infection.

rationale: Langerhans cell sarcoma; HCMV IgG was positive (5.6) while IgM was negative, indicating historic rather than recent HCMV infection (E0 contradicted).

evidence_items.source_quote: Combined with the results of immunohistochemistry, cluster of differentiation (CD) 68(+), pan-cytokeratin(-), CD34(-), S100(-), and CMV(-) confirmed T. marneffei infection.

rationale: HIV with Talaromyces marneffei colitis; blood CMV-DNA was <4.00E+02 copies/mL and colonic biopsy immunohistochemistry was negative for CMV (C1 refutation / low-level without end-organ disease).

evidence_items.source_quote: All serological tests for hepatitis B, hepatitis C, HIV, Lyme disease, brucellosis, rickettsial infection, Parvo B-19, cytomegalovirus were negative, as well as tumor markers.

rationale: JIA with thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura; serological test for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Blood and urine cultures were also negative, as well as all serological work ups, including HBV, HCV, HIV, EBV, CMV, Rubella, Toxoplasma, and Herpes Simplex.

rationale: Pregnant woman with fetal death and TTP; serological workup for CMV was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Reverse transcriptase-polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) analyses for detection of cytomegalovirus (CMV), Epstein-Barr virus (EBV), polyomavirus JC, enterovirus, herpes simplex virus, human herpesvirus type 6 (HHV-6), and varicella zoster virus genome in CSF came back negative.

rationale: Kawasaki disease shock syndrome; CSF RT-PCR and serology for CMV were negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: The patient's serum tested negative for HIV, and no cytomegalovirus, Epstein-Barr virus, or human herpes virus-8 (HHV-8) replication was detected.

rationale: Multicentric Castleman disease and CMML; no cytomegalovirus replication was detected (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Cytomegalovirus inclusions were undetectable on colonic biopsy specimens 1 week prior to this admission (shown in Fig. 3a-d).

rationale: Acute severe ulcerative colitis on secukinumab; cytomegalovirus inclusions were undetectable on colonic biopsy specimens (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Antimicrobial prophylaxis included aciclovir (post-transplant switched to foscarnet because of cytomegalovirus-positivity of donor and recipient) and micafungin (1 x 50 mg).
Blood cultures and viral monitoring remained unremarkable.

rationale: Very severe aplastic anemia post-HSCT with disseminated Fusarium solani; donor/recipient CMV-positivity with foscarnet prophylaxis and unremarkable viral monitoring (no CMV infection).

evidence_items.source_quote: Viral causes as hepatitis A, B, C, D, E viruses, cytomegalovirus (CMV), ebstein barr virus (EBV), herpes simplex virus (HSV), varicella zoster virus (VZV); biliary obstruction (by ultrasonography); autoimmune etiology by antinuclear antibody (ANA), antismooth-muscle antibody (ASMA), anti-liver kidney microsomal antibody (anti-LKM), antimitochondrial antibody (AMA), immunoglobulin G/ G4; genetic diseases as Wilson, Hemochromatosis, alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency excluded.

rationale: Phenprobamate-induced liver injury; cytomegalovirus testing was negative/excluded (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: The results of serologic studies for Cytomegalovirus, Brucella, Legionella, Coxiella burnetii, Mycoplasma and Toxoplasma were negative.

rationale: Sarcoid-like granulomatous lymphadenitis; serologic studies for Cytomegalovirus were negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Hepatitis panel, Epstein-Barr virus, cytomegalovirus, and human immunodeficiency virus tests were negative.

rationale: Fluconazole-induced acute liver failure; cytomegalovirus test was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Viral hepatitis panel, cytomegalovirus, Epstein-Barr virus, herpes simplex virus, human immunodeficiency virus, as well as blood cultures and vasculitis workup were all negative.

rationale: Amiodarone-induced shock liver; cytomegalovirus testing was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Microbial stains, PCR, and cultures of biopsy tissue for fungi, parasites, acid-fast bacilli, HSV 1, HSV 2, CMV, SV40, M. tuberculosis, and toxoplasmosis were negative.

rationale: Rheumatoid meningitis; CSF PCR and meningeal biopsy PCR/stains for CMV were negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Laboratory tests showed no Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) IgM and Cytomegalo virus (CMV) IgM detected on serological EBV antibody screen and CMV antibody screen, but elevated plasma test for EBV-DNA(2.5 hundred copies/ml).

rationale: PIK3CD (APDS) with EBV-associated lymphoid hyperplasia and plasmablastic lymphoma; CMV IgM was not detected (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: He developed recurrent infections including cytomegalovirus reactivation on day +46 and salmonella O9 (group D1) sepsis on day +82, +144, and +204, respectively, which all resolved under appropriate therapy in an outpatient setting.

rationale: Mediastinal germ cell tumor-associated HPS post-allo-PBSCT; CMV reactivation on day +46 resolved nearly a year before the day +365 relapse admission (historical past).

evidence_items.source_quote: Tissue biopsies did not show neither pathological change and rejection nor CMV organ involvement.

rationale: Small bowel transplant recipient with Candida glabrata overgrowth; received valganciclovir prophylaxis and tissue biopsies showed no CMV organ involvement (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: The investigation of Hepatitis B and C serologies, HIV, VDRL-RPR, VZV, CMV, toxoplasma, rubella Ig M and parvovirus antibody were all negative.

rationale: EBV-triggered Henoch-Schonlein purpura vasculitis; CMV serology was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: His post-transplant course had been complicated by recurrent viral infections, including influenza and cytomegalovirus (CMV) reactivation.

rationale: Eyelid squamous cell carcinoma in situ 13 months post-SCT; CMV reactivation occurred during earlier post-transplant course (historical past).

evidence_items.source_quote: Blood cultures, respiratory bacterial culture, gastrointestinal PCR, herpes simplex virus PCR, cytomegalovirus PCR, chest x-ray, and urinalysis did not demonstrate explanatory findings.

rationale: Thyroid storm post-liver transplant; cytomegalovirus PCR did not demonstrate explanatory findings (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Human immunodeficiency virus-RNA and Epstein-Barr virus- and cytomegalovirus-DNA were undetectable by polymerase chain reaction.

rationale: STAT1 GOF with disseminated cryptococcosis; cytomegalovirus DNA was undetectable by PCR (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Syphilis, HIV, Epstein-Barr virus, cytomegalovirus, measles and rubella serologies were negative.

rationale: Coxsackievirus A6 hand-foot-and-mouth disease; cytomegalovirus serology was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: A molecular respiratory panel (xTAG  Respiratory Viral Panel FAST v2; Luminex, Austin, TX, USA) as well as serological assays (IgM) for EBV, CMV, and Parvovirus B19 were all negative.

rationale: Scrub typhus (Orientia tsutsugamushi); CMV IgM assay was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: His TORCH titres were positive for Cytomegalovirus (CMV) IgM antibodies; however urine sample was negative for PCR detection of CMV, thus ruling out congenital CMV infection.

rationale: 45-day-old boy with biliary atresia and choledochal cyst; TORCH CMV IgM was positive, but urine CMV PCR was negative, explicitly ruling out congenital CMV infection (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Serum antibodies against cytomegalovirus (CMV) and Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) were negative, and a T-SPOT TB test was negative.

rationale: Very early-onset IBD; serum antibodies against cytomegalovirus were negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: An expanded diagnostic investigation (Supplementary Appendix and Table 2) ruled out common and opportunistic infections, including Herpes viruses 6, 7, and 8, CMV, HIV, and EBV viremia, bacteremia, gastrointestinal infections, and the possibility of intestinal bacterial overgrowth syndrome.

rationale: Kidney transplant recipient with AMR and parvovirus B19 viremia; expanded investigation ruled out CMV viremia (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: After transplantation, she had cytomegalovirus infection, colon adenocarcinoma, and chronic renal allograft dysfunction.

rationale: Porphyria cutanea tarda on hemodialysis in 2014; CMV infection occurred after a 1997 kidney transplant (historical past).

evidence_items.source_quote: Histochemical study for cytomegalovirus was negative.

rationale: Wilson's disease post-OLT with Aspergillus encephalitis; histochemical study of liver biopsy for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Serological tests for arthritis related infections (such as group A Streptococcus, Borrelia, Cytomegalovirus, Epstein-Barr-Virus, andParvovirus B19) were also negative.

rationale: Clostridium difficile-associated reactive arthritis; serological test for Cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Herpes simplex virus, varicella, and cytomegalovirus cerebrospinal fluid and blood polymerase chain reaction testing were all negative so acyclovir was discontinued.

rationale: 16-day-old male with Bell's palsy; CSF and blood PCR testing for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Serological examination was negative including viral hepatitis A, B, C, HIV, EBV and CMV.

rationale: 60-year-old female with dermoid cyst and polymyositis-like syndrome; CMV serology was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: The viral workup which included CMV and hepatitis A, B, and C serological markers was negative.

rationale: HLH with CNS involvement; viral workup including CMV serological markers was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: other viral serology (HIV, hepatitis B and C virus, Epstein-Barr virus and cytomegalovirus) was negative.

rationale: Small bowel Kaposi's sarcoma post-OLT; cytomegalovirus serology was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Vitreous tap was negative for CMV, HSV-1, HSV-2, Varicella-zoster, and EBV.

rationale: Multiple sclerosis-associated intermediate uveitis; vitreous tap was negative for CMV (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Bacteriological and virological tests did not detect any infectious pathogens, including Legionella pneumoniae, Mycoplasma pneumoniae, Chlamydia pneumoniae, cytomegalovirus, and severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2).

rationale: Herbal medicine (OJT)-induced ARDS; virological tests did not detect cytomegalovirus (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: An infectious panel was negative for cytomegalovirus, Epstein-Barr virus, hepatitis B, hepatitis C, herpes simplex virus, HIV, mumps, toxoplasmosis, and varicella.

rationale: Giant cell myocarditis; infectious panel was negative for cytomegalovirus (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Immunostaining was negative for cytomegalovirus (CMV) and H pylori and cytokeratin immunostains were additionally negative for metastatic infiltration (Supplemental Figures S1 and S2).

rationale: Pembrolizumab-induced gastritis; gastric biopsy immunostaining was negative for cytomegalovirus (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Viral causes were excluded with nasopharyngeal swab for the respiratory pathogen panel, including enteroviruses, and serology for HIV and CMV.

rationale: Addison's disease presenting in adrenal crisis; serology for CMV was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Based on the kidney biopsy results and significant hyperbilirubinemia, testing was done for bacteremia, influenza, tuberculosis, HIV, tick-borne diseases, Hantavirus infection, acute viral hepatitis (A, B, C, E, CMV, EBV, and VZV) and vasculitis, which were all negative or normal.

rationale: Icteric leptospirosis; testing for acute viral hepatitis including CMV was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: The results were all negative except for reactive CMV IgG with negative CMV IgM and low C3 66 mg/dL (reference 90~180).

rationale: Post-ChAdOx1 nCoV-19 vaccine myocarditis; only CMV IgG was reactive with negative CMV IgM, indicating latent seropositivity (E0 contradicted).

evidence_items.source_quote: Laboratory examination showed white blood cell (WBC): 14.19*109/L, neutrophil% (NE%): 94.2%, procalcitonin (PCT): 1.73 ng/ml, 1-3-beta-D Glucan test (G-test): <10 pg/ml (<10 pg/ml), and galactomannan test (GM-test): 0.25 (<0.5), Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) and cytomegalovirus (CMV): negative.

rationale: Nocardia farcinica pneumonia post-OLT; cytomegalovirus testing was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Bronchoalveolar lavage sampling was negative for acid-fast bacilli, Nocardia cultures, and CMV DNA.

rationale: Hantavirus cardiopulmonary syndrome; BAL sampling was negative for CMV DNA (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Transplant-related complications due to the consequent use of a high-dose steroid for long time for GVHD included multiple episodes of reactivation of cytomegalovirus responded to antiviral therapy, sarcopenia, and fracture of the head of the femur surgically resolved.

rationale: Neurocysticercosis 320 days post-haplo-HSCT; donor was CMV IgG+ and recipient had prior CMV reactivations during earlier GVHD steroid therapy (historical past).

evidence_items.source_quote: The PCR test for cytomegalovirus (CMV) and Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) was negative.

rationale: HSV esophagitis and eosinophilic esophagitis in HIV; PCR test for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: The infectious aetiology was also discarded after negative hepatitis B and hepatitis C virus, HIV, EBV, cytomegalovirus serology, and tuberculin skin test.

rationale: Leber's hereditary optic neuropathy (11778/ND4); cytomegalovirus serology was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: However, immunostaining for EBV, EBER, CMV, HSV, and adenovirus and special stains for fungi were all negative.

rationale: Intestinal transplant rejection; allograft biopsy immunostaining for CMV was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Endocrine test results (thyroid stimulating hormone, free triiodothyronine, free thyroxin, ACTH, cortisol, and 17-hydroxylproline) were normal while tests for viral infections (cytomegalovirus, hepatitis B, adenovirus, as well as Ebstein Bar, coxsackie, and rota viruses) were negative.

rationale: Cow's milk protein allergy in an infant; tests for cytomegalovirus were negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Mycoplasma, influenza cytomegalovirus, hepatitis B, hepatitis C, human immunodeficiency virus, and Epstein-Barr virus serology were also negative.

rationale: Chronic ITP secondary to dengue; cytomegalovirus serology was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: At that time, the diagnostic workup included: infections (serological tests against CMV, HCV, Toxocara canis, Toxoplasma gondii, Ascaris lumbricoides), autoimmune disorders (antiglobulin Coombs tests, ANA, ANCA autoantibodies), and metabolic diseases (Niemann-Pick A/B, Gaucher disease), all negative.

rationale: Child with persistent splenomegaly and pancytopenia; serological tests against CMV were negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Immunohistochemical staining for CMV was negative.

rationale: Follow-up kidney biopsy and genetic analysis of case 458 (NPHS1); renal biopsy CMV immunohistochemistry and electron microscopy were negative for CMV nephropathy (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Copy numbers for cytomegalovirus, varicella-zoster virus, and BK virus (human polyoma virus 1) were below the detection limit.

rationale: Stage IV DLBCL with disseminated HSV-1; CMV copy numbers were below the detection limit (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Serological tests for hepatitis B virus (HBV), hepatitis C virus (HCV), human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), cytomegalovirus (CMV), toxoplasmosis, rubella, and EBV were all negative.

rationale: Hepatitis A acute liver failure; serological test for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: IHC staining was negative for CMV.

rationale: Ph+ ALL post-HSCT with gastric GVHD and GAVE; gastric/duodenal biopsy IHC staining was negative for CMV (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: A full septic work up was negative including negative serology for HIV, hepatitis A, B, C, and CMV.

rationale: Azathioprine-induced Sweet's syndrome in microscopic polyangiitis; serology for CMV was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: CSF was also negative for EBV, HSV, VDRL, West Nile virus, CMV, cryptococcal antigens, and oligo-clonal bands with elevated myelin basic protein.

rationale: JC virus-related rhombencephalitis / PML; CSF was negative for CMV (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Serology for hepatitis A, hepatitis B, hepatitis C, human immunodeficiency virus, and cytomegalovirus was negative.

rationale: Cyclic neutropenia; serology for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Viral serologies (hepatitis A/B/C, EBV, CMV, HSV, and VZV), autoimmune studies (IgG, ANA, smooth muscle antibody, and mitochondrial antibody), and ceruloplasmin were normal as well as serum electrolytes, thyroid function tests, ammonia level, and stool studies.

rationale: Allopurinol-induced DRESS syndrome; CMV viral serology was normal (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Studies on karyotype, thalassemia, Parvovirus B19, cytomegalovirus, Toxoplasmosis, and antinuclear antibodies were all normal.

rationale: Hydrops fetalis due to anti-E alloimmunization; cytomegalovirus studies were normal (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: The test for CMV antigenemia was negative.

rationale: Invasive pulmonary aspergillosis post-heart transplant; CMV and CMV antigenemia tests were negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: The culture of bacteria and mycobacterium tuberculosis and the detection of viral nucleic acid for retrovirus, herpes virus 1 and 2, rhinovirus, Epstein-Barr (EB) virus, and cytomegalovirus in CSF were negative.

rationale: Polymicrobial anaerobic bacterial meningitis; CSF viral nucleic acid detection for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Human immunodeficiency virus, sera cytomegalovirus, hepatitis B serology, and hepatitis C serology were negative.

rationale: Angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma; serum cytomegalovirus testing was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Although he did not have CMV infection, after discussion with the family and care team, it was decided that this patient would also be treated with HCT for his T-B-NK+ SCID phenotype.

rationale: Younger sibling of case 480 with X-MAID (MSN) SCID; explicitly did not have CMV infection (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Blood cultures were negative and serologic tests for EBV, CMV, Brucella, HSV, HIV, and HCV were negative.

rationale: Q fever (Coxiella burnetii); serologic test for CMV was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Screening tests for hepatitis B, hepatitis C, cytomegalovirus, and Epstein-Barr virus were all negative.

rationale: Macro-AST; screening test for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: His immunoglobulin levels were within normal range, elevated for ESR and positive of immunoglobulin G for anti-Epstein Barr viruses, rubella viruses, cytomegalovirus, herpes simplex virus, and antinuclear antibodies.

rationale: PRKCD-deficient ALPS-related syndrome; positive anti-CMV IgG only, reflecting past exposure without active CMV disease (E0 contradicted).

evidence_items.source_quote: Infections were excluded after screening for viral (including cytomegalovirus, Epstein-Barr virus, herpes simplex virus 1 and 2, and parvovirus B19) and other infections.

rationale: Primary acquired pure red cell aplasia; viral screening for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Additional work-up including HIV, EBV, CMV, HSV, varicella, and hepatitis B and C serologies were all negative.

rationale: WHIM syndrome (CXCR4); CMV serology was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Blood cultures, serology for Epstein Barr virus (EBV) and cytomegalovirus (CMV), bone marrow biopsy and flow cytometry were all negative.

rationale: Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease; serology for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Serological screening for cytomegalovirus, herpes simplex virus, HIV and hepatitis B were negative.

rationale: Adalimumab-induced thrombocytopenia in RA; serological screening for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Serologic evaluation ruled out Epstein-Barr virus, cytomegalovirus, measles, varicella-zoster virus, parvovirus, and human immunodeficiency virus.

rationale: MRSA sepsis with parotiditis and pancytopenia; serologic evaluation ruled out cytomegalovirus (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: A routine laboratory workup was performed including complete blood cell count, erythrocyte sedimentation rate (11 mm/h), infectious - including VDRL, FTA-ABS, herpes simplex virus and cytomegalovirus serology - and inflammatory tests, quantiFERON-TB gold test, homocysteine, anticardiolipin antibody, lupus anticoagulant, antinuclear antibody, human leukocyte antigen-B27 (HLA-B27), all with negative results.

rationale: Bilateral acute iris transillumination (BAIT) syndrome; cytomegalovirus serology was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Stem cell donor was Cytomegalovirus (CMV) seronegative, while the patient was CMV seronegative and Herpes Simplex Virus (HSV) seropositive.

rationale: HHV-6 encephalitis post-PBSCT; both donor and recipient were CMV seronegative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: A viral serology for hepatitis, HIV, Epstein-Barr virus, Cytomegalovirus, Parvovirus, Mycoplasma, Influenza A/B, Respiratory Syncytial Virus, Rhinovirus, Enterovirus (Coxsackie A, Coxsackie B), and Adenovirus were negative for acute or active infection.

rationale: Post-COVID-19 vaccine perimyocarditis; viral serology for Cytomegalovirus was negative for acute or active infection (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: EBV VCA Ig M, EBV VCA Ig G, and Anti-CMV Ig G were detected as positive; EBV EA, Anti-CMV IG m were detected as negative.

rationale: Reactive arthritis secondary to hepatic hydatid cyst; anti-CMV IgG was positive while anti-CMV IgM was negative, indicating latent seropositivity (E0 contradicted).

evidence_items.source_quote: The levels of antibodies to the following pathogens were measured: parvovirus B19 (B19), herpes simplex virus, varicella zoster virus, parainfluenza virus, coxsackievirus A and B, cytomegalovirus, measles virus, rubella virus, mumps virus, and Epstein-Barr virus, as well as fecal adenovirus antigen, which has been reported as the other responsible organism of post-infectious glomerulonephritis (PIGN). However, no causative organisms were identified.

rationale: Infection-related endocapillary proliferative glomerulonephritis; CMV antibody testing failed to identify a causative organism (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: CMV DNA, beta-D-glucan, galactomannan resulted as negative on new repeated samples, with blood, sputum and urine cultures negative.

rationale: Persistent COVID-19 and Pneumocystis pneumonia in NHL on rituximab; CMV DNA on BALF and repeated blood samples was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Serological analyzes for Cytomegalovirus, Epstein-Barr virus, C hepatitis virus, and HIV were negative; cytological evaluation of the pericardial drainage showed activated mesothelial cells.

rationale: Cardiac high-grade B-cell lymphoma; serological analysis for Cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Further tests for opportunistic infections, including coccidiomycosis antigen/antibody, cryptococcal antigen, tuberculosis, varicella zoster virus (VZV), and cytomegalovirus (CMV) were also negative.

rationale: Disseminated HSV-1 in HIV; testing for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Epstein-Barr virus DNA and cytomegalovirus DNA were negative.

rationale: Multiple splenic abscesses; cytomegalovirus DNA was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: The serologic test showed negative findings for anti-HAV immunoglobulin M (HAV IgM), HB surface antigen, HB core IgM, HCV IgG, HEV IgA, cytomegalovirus IgM, Epstein-Barr virus IgM, and human immunodeficiency virus IgM/IgG antibodies.

rationale: Parvovirus B19-induced hepatitis-associated aplastic anemia; cytomegalovirus IgM was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Serology tests for Mycoplasma, Legionella, cytomegalovirus, Epstein-Barr virus, adenovirus, influenza, parainfluenza and respiratory syncitial virus were negative, as was the Quantiferon-TB gold In-tube.

rationale: Gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel-induced organizing pneumonia; serology test for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Parvovirus B19, Hepatitis C and B, EBV and CMV infections were excluded.

rationale: Infantile vitamin B12 deficiency; CMV infection was excluded (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: During the hospitalization, main viral [Hepatitis A, B, and C and minor hepatotropic viruses serology (e.g., Epstein Barr Virus and Cytomegalovirus)], autoimmune [anti - nuclear, smooth muscle, liver and kidney microsomes, liver cytosol, endomysium, tissue transglutaminase antibodies], toxic and common metabolic (Wilson disease, hereditary fructose intolerance) causes of hypertransaminasemia were ruled out by appropriate tests and anamnesis.

rationale: Multiple acyl-CoA dehydrogenase deficiency (ETFDH); Cytomegalovirus serology was ruled out (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Viral serological tests is positive for Epstein-Barr virus IgG, Coxsackievirus A9 and B (1-6) IgG, Echovirus IgG, Parvovirus B19 IgG, Human Herpes virus 6 (HHV-6) IgG and Rubeola IgG and negative for Epstein-Barr virus IgM, Coxsackievirus A9 and B (1-6) IgM, Echovirus IgM, Parvovirus B19 IgM, Human HHV-6 IgM, Hepatitis A IgG/M, Hepatitis B, Human Immunodeficiency virus (HIV) and Human Cytomegalovirus IgG/M.

rationale: Asymptomatic follow-up 5 years after chest pain; Human Cytomegalovirus IgG/M was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: There were no giant cells, viral inclusions, Herpes Simple x1 or 2, cytomegalovirus, Epstein-Barr virus, or Toxoplasma immunoreactivity.

rationale: Crystal-storing histiocytosis of the temporal lobe; brain tissue immunoreactivity for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Serologic tests for hepatitis B and C, HIV, Epstein-Barr virus, cytomegalovirus, and toxoplasmosis were negative.

rationale: Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease; serologic test for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: At the age of 7, he was diagnosed with severe maculopathy secondary to multifactorial causes (previous CMV infection, microangiopathy damage, etc.), including calcineurine inhibitors.

rationale: IPEX syndrome (FOXP3) post-HSCT and kidney transplant; previous CMV infection mentioned only as a historical contributor to maculopathy at age 7 (historical past).

evidence_items.source_quote: We therefore tested blood antibodies directed to cytomegalovirus, Epstein-Barr virus, human immunodeficiency virus, herpes simplex virus 1/2, hepatitis B, C, and A virus, respiratory syncytial virus, enterovirus, adenovirus, and parvovirus to exclude viral myocarditis. Coxiella, chlamydia, borrelia, rickettsia, and Syphilis antibodies were also measured, all of them yielded negative results.

rationale: Takotsubo cardiomyopathy; blood antibodies directed to cytomegalovirus were negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Other blood parameters were normal and included blood smear, coagulation tests, hemolysis parameters, liver and renal functions, proteinuria and urinary sediment, HIV/viral hepatitis B and C/CMV/EBV/H. pylori serologies, serum immunofixation, autoantibodies (antinuclear, antineutrophil cytoplasmic antibodies, anti-nucleosome, anti-nucleoproteins), direct and indirect antiglobulin tests, and vitamins dosage (B9 and B12).

rationale: IFNbeta-1a-induced immune thrombocytopenia; CMV serology was normal (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Polymerase chain reaction (PCR) performed from the CSF sample for CMV, HSV, and EBV identification was negative.

rationale: HIV-related PML (JC virus); CSF PCR for CMV was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Serologic tests for viral infections--including antibodies against EBV, cytomegalovirus, herpes, Hepatitis A, B, and C viruses, and HIV--were negative.

rationale: Hantaan virus-associated hemophagocytic syndrome; serologic test for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: The serological test for toxoplasma, rubella, cytomegalovirus and herpes virus were negative in the mother and the patient.

rationale: Congenital Zika virus syndrome; serological test for cytomegalovirus was negative in mother and patient (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Borrelia, syphilis, cytomegalovirus, HIV and human T-lymphotropic virus Type 1 serology were negative.

rationale: Neurolymphomatosis (DLBCL); cytomegalovirus serology was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Differentials considered for this patient who was a recent traveler, immunocompromised (due to RA treatment) presenting with pyrexia of unknown origin, pancytopenia, acute liver failure, and respiratory distress, included acute viral hepatitis (A, B, C, and E), cytomegalovirus (CMV), Epstein-Barr virus (EBV), etc.

rationale: Disseminated histoplasmosis with HLH; CMV was listed only in the initial differential diagnosis without positive CMV findings (ruled out).

evidence_items.source_quote: CMV PCR, coxsackie viral PCR, adenovirus PCR, Lyme serology, anaplasmosis serology, ehrlichiosis serology, mycoplasma PCR, influenza A and B testing, COVID-19 PCR, HIV screen, and hepatitis testing were negative.

rationale: AML-related myocarditis and Sweet's syndrome; CMV PCR was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: TORCH studies returned negative with the exception of Toxoplasma IgG (immunoglobulin G) positivity >400.0 IU/mL (range: 7.1 IU/mL or less:not detected; 7.2-8.7 IU/mL:indeterminate; 8.8 IU/mL or greater:detected).

rationale: Congenital toxoplasmosis chorioretinal scars; TORCH studies including CMV were negative except for Toxoplasma IgG (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Serological studies for EBV, CMV, HIV, HBV, HCV, Toxoplasma gondii, Mycoplasma pneumoniae and Parvovirus B19 were negative.

rationale: Hyperhemolysis syndrome in pregnant beta-thalassemia intermedia; serological study for CMV was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Clostridium difficile toxins (stool) and early cytomegalovirus antigen (stool and blood) were negative.

rationale: Ulcerative colitis with Acremonium kiliense fungemia; early cytomegalovirus antigen in stool and blood was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: PCR for neurotropic viruses (herpes simplex virus, varicella zoster virus, cytomegalovirus, Epstein-Barr virus and enterovirus) and borrelia were negative.

rationale: Progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy (JC virus); serum CMV serology and CSF CMV PCR were negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Infectious workup included extensive blood and urine testing for Hepatitis A, B, C, HIV, herpes simplex, varicella, cytomegalovirus (CMV), Epstein Barr Virus (EBV), acid-fast bacilli, and respiratory viruses.

rationale: Autoimmune hepatitis cirrhosis with HLH; infectious workup included CMV testing without positive CMV findings.

evidence_items.source_quote: Upon admission, his AKI workup included imaging of the allograft, infectious workup (cytomegalovirus, Epstein-Barr virus, polyoma BK virus testing), and fluid management.

rationale: Histoplasmosis-induced hypercalcemia and AKI post-kidney transplant; AKI workup included CMV testing with histoplasmosis confirmed.

evidence_items.source_quote: Serology for toxoplasma, hepatitis virus, cytomegalovirus and rubella was negative.

rationale: Infantile malignant osteopetrosis (TCIRG1); serology for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: A routine investigation performed prior to HSCT showed hepatitis A virus (HAV), hepatitis B virus (HBV), hepatitis C virus (HCV), HEV, cytomegalovirus (CMV), and Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) negative.

rationale: Very severe aplastic anemia post-HSCT with chronic Hepatitis E; pre-HSCT investigation was negative for cytomegalovirus (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Tests for IgM antibodies to hepatitis A virus, hepatitis C virus, human immunodeficiency virus and cytomegalovirus were all negative.

rationale: Severe acute Hepatitis B; IgM antibody test for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Subsequently, IgG anti-CMV avidity and CMV-polymerase chain reaction (PCR) were ordered, with negative results. Having established that it was a previous infection, the infectious disease specialist determined that the patient could undertake therapy with a biological drug while monitoring IgG anti-CMV avidity and CMV-PCR every three months.

rationale: Psoriasis patient evaluated in 2019 for secukinumab; had acute CMV infection 1 year earlier (May 2018), but current CMV-PCR and IgG avidity confirmed only previous infection with no reactivation during 12-month follow-up (E0 contradicted).

evidence_items.source_quote: It was 1-1-2 HLA mismatched, CMV IgG D+/R+, with a cold ischemia time of 17 hours.

rationale: Deceased-donor kidney transplant in thalassemia intermedia; only baseline CMV IgG D+/R+ serostatus is mentioned without CMV infection.

evidence_items.source_quote: The antibodies for hepatitis virus and several serological tests for other viruses (parvovirus, cytomegalovirus, rubella virus, adenovirus, respiratory syncytial virus, influenza virus and parainfluenza virus) were all negative.

rationale: Fulminant type 1 diabetes mellitus with EBV reactivation; serological tests for cytomegalovirus were negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: In the absence of positive bacterial/fungal culture tests or positive serological/blood tests for Aspergillus antigen, Candida albicans antigen, Mycoplasma antibody, beta-d-glucan, and CMV-pp65 antigen, the patient received empiric antibiotic treatments, including piperacillin/tazobactam, ciprofloxacin, voriconazole, and liposomal amphotericin B.

rationale: Follicular lymphoma presenting at age 68 with HHV-6 pneumonitis; had prior CMV retinitis 15 months earlier, but current admission CMV pp65 antigen and BAL CMV PCR were negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Serology for hepatitis A, B, and C, toxoplasma, rubella, cytomegalovirus, herpes simplex was negative.

rationale: Smith-Lemli-Opitz syndrome (DHCR7); serology for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) gram stain, culture and a CSF PCR Panel (with targets for H.influenzae, L.monocytogenes, N.meningitidis, S.agalactiae, S.pneumoniae, Cytomegalovirus, Enterovirus, Herpes simplex virus 1 and 2, Human herpesvirus 6, Human parechovirus, Varicella Zoster virus, Cryptococcus neoformans/gatti, and E.coli K1) failed to reveal an infectious etiology.

rationale: Acute disseminated encephalomyelitis (ADEM) with respiratory adenovirus; CSF PCR panel was negative for Cytomegalovirus (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Tests for infective causes including viruses (coxsackie, CMV, EBV, viral hepatitis, HSV, HIV, and influenza) and parasites (Schistosoma, Giardia, Toxocara, Trichinella, and Strongyloides) were negative, with the exception of influenza A and B antibody titers, which were 1 : 64 and 1 : 8, respectively.

rationale: Eosinophilic polymyositis; viral testing for CMV was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Pathology was consistent with inflammation of the esophageal mucosa with necrotic features, with negative immunohistochemistry for CMV and fungal PAS stain.

rationale: Clozapine-associated esophagitis; esophageal biopsy immunohistochemistry for CMV was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Serology for viral hepatitis, Epstein-Barr virus, and Cytomegalovirus were negative.

rationale: Relapsing yellow fever hepatitis; serology for Cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: All of the evaluated viral serologies were negative and included Epstein-Barr-Virus (EBV), Cytomegalovirus (CMV), BK Virus (BKV), and Parvovirus B19 (Table 4).

rationale: Thymoglobulin/Rituximab-induced serum sickness post-renal transplant; CMV serology was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Tests for virus antibodies, including anti-herpes simplex, anti-rubella, anti-cytomegalovirus, and anti-Coxsackie virus, in the CSF were negative.

rationale: Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease; CSF anti-cytomegalovirus antibody test was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: There was no evidence of infection caused by hepatitis B virus, hepatitis C virus, cytomegalovirus, Epstein-Barr virus, or HIV.

rationale: TAFRO syndrome; no evidence of cytomegalovirus infection (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: The patient was also found to be negative for antibodies to HIV, hepatitis A, B, C, D virus, CMV, EBV, Borrelia and malaria.

rationale: Visceral leishmaniasis-associated HPS; negative for antibodies to CMV (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Serological investigations ruled out C. pneumoniae, adenovirus, cytomegalovirus, and human immunodeficiency virus infections.

rationale: Mulibrey nanism (TRIM37) with interstitial lung disease; serological investigation ruled out cytomegalovirus (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: On day five, the patient underwent a bronchoscopy with bronchoalveolar lavage (BAL) which revealed a negative workup for herpes simplex virus, cytomegalovirus, legionella, mycoplasma, influenza, beta-D-glucan, and cryptococcal pathogens.

rationale: Invasive pulmonary aspergillosis post-two heart transplants; prior CMV-induced chronic rejection was 5 years earlier, and current BAL workup was negative for cytomegalovirus (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Screening for viral hepatitis A, hepatitis B, hepatitis C, HIV, and CMV was negative.

rationale: Acute Hepatitis E during R-CHOP chemotherapy; screening for CMV was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Serological testing for HIV-1/2 Antigen/Antibody, CMV IgM, EBV IgM, Mycoplasma IgM and antiganglioside IgM antibodies was negative.

rationale: Guillain-Barre syndrome post-COVID-19 vaccine; CMV IgM was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: No viral etiology (TORCH, which includes Toxoplasmosis, Other [syphilis, varicella-zoster, parvovirus B19], Rubella, cytomegalovirus, and herpes infections, [para] influenza, respiratory syncytial virus, adenovirus) could be demonstrated.

rationale: Neonatal neutropenia from maternal adalimumab/INH; TORCH workup including cytomegalovirus showed no viral etiology (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: The bacteriological, viral (Epstein Barr virus, cytomegalovirus, human immunodeficiency virus, hepatitis B and hepatitis C, and human herpes virus 8 (HHV8)), and parasite evaluation were negative.

rationale: Castleman disease in a 13-year-old girl; viral evaluation for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: There was serological evidence of past EBV and cytomegalovirus exposure.

rationale: Primary cutaneous plasmablastic lymphoma; serological evidence of past cytomegalovirus exposure only (historical past, E0 contradicted).

evidence_items.source_quote: SARS-CoV-2 RT-PCR of the nasopharyngeal swab and serology to dengue, Chikungunya, Zika, HIV, hepatitis B and C, Cytomegalovirus (CMV), Epstein-Barr virus (EBV), toxoplasmosis, and rubella were negative.

rationale: VITT post-ChAdOx1 nCoV-19 vaccine; serology to Cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Initial blood tests and liver function test revealed no abnormalities other than mild elevation of cytomegalovirus IgG antibody (23.7 U/ml).

rationale: Abernethy malformation type II with nodular hyperplasia; mild elevation of CMV IgG antibody (23.7 U/mL) only, reflecting past exposure (E0 contradicted).

evidence_items.source_quote: Antinuclear antibody, in addition to toxoplasmosis, rubella, cytomegalovirus, herpes simplex, HIV, and syphilis, as well as the culture for TB, were all negative.

rationale: Disseminated BCG/TB; cytomegalovirus testing was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Repeated blood and urine cultures and a thorough infection screen including a viral panel for herpes zoster, herpes simplex (HSV-1, HSV-2), Epstein-Barr virus (EBV), cytomegalovirus, hepatitis B and C, HIV, coxsackie, and parvovirus B19 viruses were negative.

rationale: SLE-associated macrophage activation syndrome; viral panel for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Cytomegalovirus (CMV)-colitis was excluded based on negative CMV-DNA in the blood and tissue of the patient, and other infectious causes could also be ruled out.

rationale: Acute severe ulcerative colitis; CMV-colitis was excluded based on negative CMV-DNA in blood and colonic tissue (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Polymerase chain reaction (PCR) assay of the serum was negative for cytomegalovirus DNA.

rationale: Disseminated mucormycosis post-kidney transplant; serum PCR was negative for cytomegalovirus DNA (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Some of the microbiologic tests were as follows: anti-HBs (-), HbsAg(-), anti-HIV (-), Brucella agglutination test (-), CMV IgM (-), and IgG(+).

rationale: Refractory polyarticular JIA and nail psoriasis; CMV IgM was negative and IgG was positive (latent seropositivity, E0 contradicted).

evidence_items.source_quote: These PCR examinations of the CSF from the day of admission were negative for herpes simplex virus, varicella zoster virus, Cytomegalovirus, Epstein-Barr virus, Enterovirus, and Mycoplasma pneumoniae, specific PCR for Streptococcus pneumoniae, specific PCR for Neisseria meningitidis, and a broad range 16sRNA PCR for bacterial DNA.

rationale: Listeria monocytogenes meningitis; CSF PCR was negative for Cytomegalovirus (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: There is no evidence of chronic AMR, CMV, and adenovirus negative.

rationale: Acute AMR post-kidney transplant during DAA therapy for HCV; CMV test was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Therefore, serological tests for HAV, HBV, HCV, EBV, CMV hepatotropic viruses infections were performed with negative results; autoimmunity tests revealed elevated angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) and a 1:160 title of the antinuclear antibody (ANA) with nucleolar pattern.

rationale: Dabrafenib/trametinib-induced sarcoid-like reaction; serological test for CMV was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: EBV viral capsid antigen (VCA) immunoglobulin (Ig) G was 207 IU/mL, and EBV-determined nuclear antigen (EBNA) IgG was 71.1 IU/mL, with a negative EBV VCA IgM and a positive CMV IgG with a negative CMV IgM.

rationale: Golimumab-associated EBV-LPD in RA; CMV IgG was positive with negative CMV IgM, indicating latent seropositivity (E0 contradicted).

evidence_items.source_quote: Serology testing for congenital infections (Cytomegalovirus, Rubella, Toxoplasma gondii) and Ebstein Barr virus, was negative.

rationale: Pontocerebellar hypoplasia 2 (TSEN54); serology testing for congenital CMV was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: The IgM antibodies directed against the other investigated viruses were negative.

rationale: EBV reactivation after infliximab in RA; CMV IgM was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Testing for antibodies to HSV1, HSV2, VZV, CMV, EBV, HBV, HCV, HIV in serum and cerebrospinal fluid, as well as sarcoidosis and tumor markers in serum revealed no pathological values.

rationale: NMO-SD longitudinally extensive transverse myelitis; serum and CSF testing for CMV antibodies revealed no pathological values (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: To further investigate potential secondary causes of HLH, viral serologies were obtained, which were negative for human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), cytomegalovirus (CMV), Herpes simplex virus (HSV) type 1 and 2, Epstein-Barr virus (EBV), hepatitis B virus, and hepatitis C virus.

rationale: Secondary HLH; viral serology for cytomegalovirus was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Secondary causes of aplastic anemia including hepatitis B, C, HIV, CMV, Parvovirus b19, and EBV were reported negative.

rationale: COVID-19-associated aplastic anemia; secondary testing for CMV was negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Viral infections (CMV, human immunodeficiency virus, hepatotropic viruses, herpes simplex virus, influenza virus, parvovirus, adenovirus and atypical respiratory pathogens) were promptly ruled out.

rationale: Post-COVID-19 secondary HLH; CMV infection was ruled out (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Serologies for hepatitis A, B, C and E viruses, Epstein-Barr virus, cytomegalovirus and human immunodeficiency virus were negative.

rationale: SARS-CoV-2-associated FUO and lobular hepatitis; serial serologies for cytomegalovirus were negative (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: Serum examination showed the following: PR3-ANCA < 1 IU/mL, MPO-ANCA 124.0 IU/mL, cytomegalovirus complement fixation test 8, ferritin 471 ng/mL, and CH50 60.0 U/mL.

rationale: Microscopic polyangiitis; cytomegalovirus complement fixation test was 8 (low baseline/past titer without active CMV disease).

evidence_items.source_quote: Serology for hepatitis B, C and HIV I and II were all negative, while IgG was positive for toxoplasmosis, cytomegalovirus and Epstein-Barr virus.

rationale: DENV2 and YFV coinfection; IgG was positive for cytomegalovirus only, reflecting past exposure (E0 contradicted).

evidence_items.source_quote: Tests to detect antibodies to Epstein-Barr virus and cytomegalovirus were both negative for immunoglobulin M (IgM) but positive for immunoglobulin G (IgG).

rationale: Acute Hepatitis E in RA on tocilizumab; CMV IgM was negative and IgG was positive, indicating past exposure (E0 contradicted).

evidence_items.source_quote: The serology for cytomegalovirus and Epstein-Barr was negative for IgM, but positive for IgG.

rationale: Dengue with pericardial effusion and leukocytoclastic vasculitis; CMV serology was negative for IgM and positive for IgG (latent seropositivity, E0 contradicted).

evidence_items.source_quote: Furthermore, we excluded other causes of infections like potential bacterial and virus infections, e.g., cytomegalovirus, Epstein-Barr virus, and adenovirus.

rationale: PIMS-TS / MIS-C; cytomegalovirus infection was excluded (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: X-cyton analysis of the anterior chamber aspirate was negative for organisms like Mycobacterial Tuberculosis, Toxoplasma Gondii, Hepes Simplex Virus, Cytomegalovirus and Varicella Zoster Virus.

rationale: Post-typhoid immune-mediated retinitis; X-cyton multiplex PCR of anterior chamber aspirate was negative for Cytomegalovirus (C1 refutation).

evidence_items.source_quote: no definitive causative infectious disease was identified after interpreting various laboratory studies for HIV 1/2, rapid plasma reagin, cytomegalovirus
